Rahul Gandhi Criticizes System After Meeting Students in Prayagraj

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi addressed students in Prayagraj, stating that the "defeat" was not theirs but of the "system" that failed to reward their hard work. He engaged in a dialogue with students as part of the 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' program. Gandhi criticized the central government's system following this interaction.
